title: Hazmat hood with respirator
concept: Soldiers in yellow hazmat suits sweeping a dark lab with torches.
sheet: Studio product photograph of a yellow rubberised hazmat suit hood with a full-face respirator built in: a dark tinted visor and two round filter canisters at the cheeks, shown on its own as if worn by an invisible person, front three-quarter view. Whole object in frame with generous space around it, plain light grey seamless background, soft even studio light, no floor, no shadows, no text or logos.
notes: Budget: 2,000 triangles, 1K maps (a rigid part fixed to the procedural skeleton's head bone). Gameplay camera sees it at about 4 cm per pixel.
